description: Keeper leases, credential-free retry receipt, expiry, fencing and crash/resume of staged rekey.

producer.crypto: Public test-only broker JWKs and deterministic fixture entropy. All verification uses real WebCrypto.

test_only_keys.warning: PUBLIC TEST-ONLY PRIVATE KEYS. Never use for deployment.

response.body: {"ok":false,"code":"E_POLICY_CONFLICT","error":"tw: epoch operation refused","next":"Check the request and try again."}

{"ok":false,"code":"E_CLAIM","error":"tw: epoch operation refused","next":"Check the request and try again."}

limitations: No credential-free rekey-claim retry receipt exists in merged production code. A fresh-nonce retry of the same request UUID without claim credentials is refused with E_POLICY_CONFLICT, leaving no durable claim token receipt.

Interruption evicts the real Durable Object through Miniflare, losing instance ports and receipt key handles while retaining SQLite. A new instance resumes the lease; expiry takes a fresh fence and retains historical staging.
